question: Using Elastic Net regression (alpha=0.1, l1_ratio=0.5), predict age from methylation data and identify the top 10 features by absolute coefficient magnitude with non-zero coefficients. Use an 80-20 train-test split (random_state=42) and fit the model on the training data only.

expected_output.guidelines: All 10 feature names must match the reference exactly; coefficient values must match within 1% relative absolute error; column order, row order, and header labels may differ.
